name: @w6w-apps/taskade
description: Manage Taskade workspaces, folders, projects, tasks, assignees, due dates, notes and AI agents through the Taskade REST API v1.

w6w.longDescription:
Taskade is a collaborative workspace where projects are outlines of tasks that teams, AI agents and automations work on together. This app connects a workflow to the Taskade REST API (v1) with a Personal Access Token.

A workflow can list the workspaces a token can see, the folders (subspaces) inside a workspace and the projects, AI agents, media and project templates inside a folder. It can read, create, copy, complete and restore projects; list, read, create, edit, move, complete, reopen and delete the tasks inside a project; read and set a task's assignees, due date and note; and read a project's members, custom fields and share link. It can also read an AI agent and its conversations.

Taskade answers every failure with an `ok: false` envelope carrying a stable `code`, and this app reports that code. Health checks verify the token, whether the API answers, the per-token rate-limit headroom and Taskade's own status page.
